# Hiking & Road Trips

> > A Pacific Northwest hiking and road trip blog by Dani & Alexandra featuring trail guides, road trip itineraries, and outdoor adventure resources across North America.

Hiking & Road Trips provides detailed hiking guides and scenic road trip itineraries primarily focused on the Pacific Northwest, Colorado Rockies, and Canadian destinations. The site covers everything from day hikes near Denver to thru-hiking the Appalachian Trail and Colorado Trail, along with comprehensive gear recommendations for outdoor adventures.

## Key Topics

- Colorado hiking
- Rocky Mountain National Park
- Pacific Northwest trails
- Road trip itineraries
- Thru-hiking guides
- Vancouver Island
- Seattle area hikes
- Appalachian Trail
- Colorado Trail
- Hiking gear recommendations
- National parks
- Trail guides
- Long-distance hiking
- Cape Breton road trips
- Outdoor accessibility

## Colorado Hiking & Road Trips

- [7 Best Hikes Near Denver That Locals Will Tell You About](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/best-hikes-near-denver): 7 local-favorite hikes near Denver in Colorado's Rocky Mountains
- [Why Sky Pond Trail in Rocky Mountain National Park is One of the Best Hikes In Colorado](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/sky-pond-trail): Sky Pond Trail guide: alpine lake hike in Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Denver to Telluride Colorado Road Trip Instead of Rocky Mountain National Park](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/denver-to-telluride): Denver to Telluride road trip alternative to Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Looking for a Thru Hike? Consider the Colorado Trail](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/colorado-trail-thru-hike): Colorado Trail thru-hike guide with itinerary & long-distance planning

## Pacific Northwest Adventures

- [Seattle to Olympic National Park: The Ultimate Scenic Road Trip](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/seattle-to-olympic-national-park): Seattle to Olympic National Park scenic road trip guide for Washington
- [Vancouver Island Road Trip 8-Day Itinerary: Seattle to Vancouver Island's Pacific Rim](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/vancouver-island-road-trip): 8-day Vancouver Island road trip from Seattle to Pacific Rim with stops

## Canadian Road Trips

- [Cabot Trail Road Trip: 3 Days in Cape Breton, Nova Scotia](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/cabot-trail-road-trip): 3-day Cabot Trail itinerary in Cape Breton with trails & campgrounds
- [3 Day Fleur de Lis and Marconi Trail Road Trip](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/fleur-de-lis-and-marconi-trail-road-trip): 3-day Cape Breton road trip exploring Fleur de Lis & Marconi Trail, NS

## Thru-Hiking & Long-Distance Trails

- [The 14 States of an Appalachian Trail Thru-Hiker](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/appalachian-trail-thru-hiker): Appalachian Trail thru-hike guide through 14 states from Georgia north
- [Looking for a Thru Hike? Consider the Colorado Trail](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/colorado-trail-thru-hike): Colorado Trail thru-hike guide with itinerary & long-distance planning

## Gear Recommendations

- [Hiking Gear Recommendations](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/gear-recommendations/hiking-gear-recommendations): Hiking gear guide: Keen shoes, CamelBak hydration & LifeStraw filter
- [Road Trip Gear Recommendations](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/gear-recommendations/road-trip-gear-recommendations): Road trip gear guide: Coleman Grill, Cooluli cooler & travel essentials

## Outdoor Topics & Resources

- [How to Prepare for the Impact of Climate Change On Your Hike](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/climate-change-hiking): Preparing for climate change impacts on hiking: air quality, heat & weather
- [Is Hiking Actually Inclusive? Surprising Ways That It's Not and What to Do About It](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/is-hiking-inclusive): Examining hiking accessibility barriers and outdoor equity issues
- [How to Virtually Visit Your Favorite U.S. National Parks](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/virtual-parks): Guide to virtually exploring U.S. national parks via online tours & webcams
- [Hiking in Missouri: 5 Supreme Spots for The Perfect Missouri Day Hike](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/hiking-in-missouri): Top 5 Missouri day hikes including Ha Ha Tonka State Park near St. Louis
- [How We Tried Out "Car Life" & Traveled Across Europe For 3 Months](https://hikingandroadtrips.com/european-car-life): 3-month Europe car life experience: nomadic travel across the continent
